	function getAuthScriptEl() {
		return document.querySelector('script[src*="mng-auth"]');

	function getAuthScriptSrc() {
		var el = getAuthScriptEl();
		return el ? el.src : '(no mng-auth script tag)';
	}

	function authDiagnostics() {
		return [
			'script=' + getAuthScriptSrc(),
			'MNGAuth=' + typeof window.MNGAuth,
			'module=' + typeof window.module,
			'exports=' + typeof window.exports,
			'define=' + typeof window.define,
			'define.amd=' + !!(window.define && window.define.amd)

	function adoptMngAuth() {
		if (window.MNGAuth && (typeof window.MNGAuth.init === 'function' || typeof window.MNGAuth.showScreen === 'function')) {
			return window.MNGAuth;
		}
		var candidates = [];
		if (window.module && window.module.exports) {

		}
		if (window.exports) {
			candidates.push(window.exports.MNGAuth || window.exports);

		for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
			var candidate = candidates[i];
			if (candidate && (typeof candidate.init === 'function' || typeof candidate.showScreen === 'function')) {
				window.MNGAuth = candidate;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'adopted MNGAuth from UMD export');

		return null;

	function waitForMngAuth() {
		if (window.__mngAuthReadyPromise) {
			return window.__mngAuthReadyPromise;

		window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (adoptMngAuth()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				resolve();
			}

				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = null;
				reject(new Error(message + ' ' + authDiagnostics()));

			function shadowUmdGlobals() {
				var saved = {
					module: window.module,
					exports: window.exports,
					define: window.define

					delete window.module;

					delete window.define;

				try {
					if (typeof saved.module !== 'undefined') {
						window.module = saved.module;

					if (typeof saved.exports !== 'undefined') {

					return;
				}

				var saved = shadowUmdGlobals();

					if (adoptMngAuth()) {

						return;
					}
					fail('CDN loaded but did not expose window.MNGAuth');
				};
				script.onerror = function () {
					restoreUmdGlobals(saved);
					fail('mng-auth.js failed to load');

	function waitForEmbedReady() {
		return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (isEmbedReady()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			var settled = false;
			var poll;

			function cleanup() {
				window.clearInterval(poll);
				document.removeEventListener('mng.auth.onFinished', onFinished);

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				resolve();
			}

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new Error(message));

					return;

				if (isEmbedReady()) {

				}

				fail('timed out waiting for #mng-modal. script=' + getAuthScriptSrc());

		});
